frames.instruction: Draw one rounded mitten silhouette with a thumb opening outward on the left and a straight wrist end; place a separate wide cuff band at the wrist.

frames.visible_job: Add six short vertical rib lines inside the cuff and one inner seam tracing the thumb base without changing its outline.
frames.instruction: Add six short vertical rib lines inside the cuff and one inner seam tracing the thumb base without changing its outline.

frames.visible_job: Add one six-armed snowflake at the center of the mitten palm while leaving its outer outline untouched.
frames.instruction: At the middle of the palm draw one small six-armed snowflake, leaving clear space around the thumb and outer mitten edge.

frames.visible_job: Draw two staggered rows of small V stitches below the snowflake and four short diagonal stitch marks near the fingertip curve.
frames.instruction: Draw two staggered rows of small V stitches below the snowflake and four short diagonal stitch marks near the fingertip curve.
Add a short loose yarn tail from one cuff corner and one broken oval shadow beneath the mitten. Keep every earlier contour fixed.

final_step.visible_job: Add soft graphite and muted blue pencil within the established mitten and cuff, preserving the stitch marks and snowflake.
final_step.instruction: Shade the existing mitten with pale blue-gray pencil, darken the cuff ribs and stitches with graphite, and keep the snowflake light. Add no new outline or motif.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved square crop shows a complete rounded mitten, a separate attached cuff and a left-facing thumb at their final size. Its blank palm gives a beginner a clear place for the later motif; no temporary guide is present.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Reading one instruction at a time against the six saved square crops shows ribs and a thumb seam, then the palm snowflake, two stitch rows and four fingertip dashes, yarn and shadow, and finally blue-gray shading. The thumb, cuff, palm curve and all prior decorations stay anchored, and there are no guide removals.

transitions.observed_addition: Six cuff rib strokes and one thumb-base seam appear inside the original mitten and cuff. The left thumb tip, rounded fingertip, cuff corners, and cuff angle remain at their earlier anchors.
transitions.instruction_match: Step 2 asks for the visible ribs and short inner seam; it does not ask the learner to redraw the outside edge.

transitions.observed_addition: One six-armed snowflake appears in the open palm, centered above the cuff. The same six ribs, thumb seam, thumb tip, cuff corners, and rounded fingertip remain visible.
transitions.instruction_match: Step 3 asks for the single palm snowflake and leaves both cuff and thumb clear, matching this crop.

transitions.observed_addition: Two staggered rows of V stitches appear below the snowflake and four diagonal marks appear near the fingertip. The six snowflake arms, cuff ribs, thumb seam, and outer shape remain fixed.
transitions.instruction_match: Step 4 directs two V rows and four fingertip dashes, exactly the new marks visible in the saved crop.

transitions.observed_addition: A loose yarn strand attaches at the left cuff corner and a broken graphite shadow sits beneath the cuff. The snowflake, V rows, four fingertip dashes, thumb seam and six cuff ribs remain.
transitions.instruction_match: Step 5 names the attached strand and low shadow; earlier decoration and the mitten silhouette remain available to copy.

transitions.observed_addition: Pale blue-gray pencil fills the established thumb, palm and cuff with visible paper tooth; the existing graphite shadow deepens. The motif, two V rows, four fingertip marks, six ribs and yarn stay in place.
transitions.instruction_match: The final instruction is a color and value pass on existing contours; it adds no structural or decorative mark.
